science_target: SQ-CF4 from R78, original 42 scientific nodes unchanged

findings.observed: Released table3 method moduli are already intercalibrated via full CF4 MCMC. Their residual differences cannot yield independent raw zero-point posterior, exact calibrated source J_cal or a new physical method variance.
findings.resolution: Report only source-product weighted group contrast with SNIA coordinate gauge, no physical calibration posterior; include e_DMcal absence. P0-B physical gate blocked until independent upstream source/posterior inputs.

findings.observed: 926 groups have multiple method-positive flags; naive method-pair independence would double-count shared group distances and PV.
findings.resolution: Profile one group common scalar a_g with weighted Laplacian, one physical group per ID. Only 922 groups have >=2 released modulus/error pairs. Verify independent explicit two-method edge formula and gauge null.

findings.observed: An initial direct construction diag(sum(w))-sum(w w^T/W) lost absolute precision in F1 gauge by ~1.5e-8 due cancelling thousands of large one-method weights.
findings.resolution: Sum only positive pair-overlap edges and set graph diagonal as negative row sum; source F1 null ~1.14e-12. Test common group shift invariance and pairwise-edge numerical comparison.

findings.observed: Four source group-ID-disjoint RA sectors are NOT upstream calibration independent; the CF4 MCMC intercalibration used all group method measurements.
findings.resolution: Call the outputs spatial residual predictive consistency, never independent calibration or astronomical coverage; explicitly keep Pi null and physical heldout false.

findings.observed: Source selected vs published table3 inclusion varies by method, optical SBF 8.57% and CAL 3.27%; this is analysis selection conditional on published groups.
findings.resolution: Do not interpret selected/released fraction as survey completeness or C_selection covariance. Keep actual source selection footprint and explicit missing selection law.

findings.observed: A coherent PV shear may be exactly in selected H03 STF mean-span, so invariant point estimates coexist with much larger conditional uncertainty; bulk velocity has different d dependence.
findings.resolution: Prove U=X A source-conditional mean invariance and covariance inflation, numerically check relative covariance theorem error ~1.41e-14. Adopt no actual fitted sigma_bulk/sigma_shear or Bianchi physical shear conclusion.

findings.observed: The source dataclass frozen flag does not prevent mutation of NumPy arrays after source loading, risking data/weight misalignment.
findings.resolution: Added full canonical array source_fingerprint (group ID,directions,modulus,errors,z,7 presence,method moduli/sigmas,CAL and family). Source tamper red-green test; source file SHA checked at load.

findings.observed: The SNIA gauge was assigned exactly 0 but its absolute source calibration uncertainty is undefined, which serializes as NaN under NumPy.
findings.resolution: Serialize that missing quantity explicitly as JSON null (never as zero uncertainty or invalid NaN); source result create-only and tested old/new data parity.
